about: The study's reference answers for the speech-onset detector (see work/freeze_reference.py). Written once; never regenerate it to make a test pass.

provenance.reference: speech_onset_ms of the speech study (tools/pkwords.py), run through a copy proven identical to it by syntax tree (check_detector_copy.py)
provenance.generator: synth.py (pure integer: a 31-bit LCG, an integer triangle phase, integer amplitudes); the TypeScript twin is src/test/synthAudio.ts
